message:
Coach v18 (Fri): Weigh-in 268.8. 7-day avg 272.3 vs 275.1 last week, about -2.8 lb/wk. Still too fast for recomp. No food logged since Wed; the fix is eating: 3,300 kcal / 270 g protein, +50 g carbs Fri-Sun.

Arms (All) is back to the full 6-exercise superset list. Thanksgiving lists are gone.

Tonight, Fri Week B Hams: RDL 235x8 then 205x10 x3, Lying Leg Curl 100x12, Walking Lunge 40s x10/leg, Leg Press 435x10 high-wide, Seated Leg Curl 140x12 all 3. 15-min incline walk after.
Sat Chest Mid: Incline Machine Press opens, 295x10 then 265x12x2. Bench 245x6 then 205x8 x2, Dips BW x10, Cable Fly 23x14. Carbs + water Fri night.
Sun Back Mid: Underhand Pulldown 172 x10-12 (rest-pause last), BB Row 205x8 then 175x10 x2, Cable Row 172x10, Straight-Arm FST-7 at 120, ONE weight all 7, flex + water. Fasted photos, shorter shorts.

Short on sleep: stop 1 rep shy on top sets, no grinders. Vacuums AM + PM. Open Lift Log after every session so it syncs.

NEW: every lift with no baseline now has an estimated Coach target from your logged lifts. First set = calibration; adjust if way off.

meals.notes: 60-90 min before lifting, low fat. Rest days (Mon/Thu): skip the rice cakes and honey, keep the shake and banana.

meals.notes: Post-workout meal. Salmon swap 2x a week. Potato or sweet potato, your pick. 10-min walk after. Fri + Sat: extra carbs (rice/potato) + teriyaki or ketchup, extra water to fill out Sat chest and Sun back.

groceries: Chicken breast 8 lb raw (Costco Kirkland pack)
Eggs 2 dozen + liquid egg whites 2 x 32 oz
Jasmine rice 10 lb bag (or microwave cups)
Optional: 96% lean ground beef 2 lb, deli turkey, tortillas
Psyllium husk, creatine, vitamin D3, fish oil (restock)

cardio.notes: Mon + Thu rest days (morning or after work), Sat after chest. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Rest days: before work or after dinner. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Right after lifting. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Cut phase cardio: workdays + Saturday post-lift. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Right after Friday legs to flush the legs. After lifting or fasted AM. Max 45 min/session; add a 2nd session rather than going longer.
Empty stomach. Exhale fully, closed-throat fake inhale, navel to spine. Start on hands and knees: 5 x 10-20 s holds, 30 s rest. Stand once 5 x 20 s is clean.
Evening, 2+ h after a meal. Same as AM: exhale fully, closed-throat fake inhale, navel to spine, 5 x 10-20 s on hands and knees.
2-3x/week, 5 min max. No weighted side bends or heavy twists.

all.name: Overhead Press
all.notes: Ramp up with 2-3 light sets (don't log them). Target 115×8 on the top set, then go to 120. Brace hard, squeeze glutes, bar over mid-foot.

all.name: Seated DB Press
all.notes: You're pre-fatigued from overhead press. Use 55s and own all 3 sets; go up when every set hits 10.

all.name: Face Pull
all.notes: Start around 117 and build to 132+. Pull to the forehead, elbows high, hold 1s.

all.name: Reverse Pec Deck
all.notes: Use 180 for all 3 sets. When all 3 hit 15, add weight. No swinging, lead with the elbows.

all.name: Lateral Raise
all.notes: Start around 105-110, strict, no trap shrug. FST-7: one weight all 7 sets, 10-12 reps, 30-45 s rest. Between sets FLEX/pose the target 10 s, building to 30 s (no stretching during the 7s). Sip ~2 oz water before and after each flex.

quads.name: Back Squat
quads.notes: Top set after ramp-ups (warm-ups not logged), then back-offs about 15-20% lighter. Control the negative.

quads.name: Hack Squat
quads.notes: Feet low and narrow, flat shoes. 4 s down, zero bounce, stop shy of lockout. 1 top set + 2 back-offs.

quads.name: Romanian Deadlift
quads.notes: Hinge, bar close, stop at mid-shin stretch.

quads.name: Seated Leg Curl
quads.notes: Lean forward, pause at full contraction.

quads.name: Leg Extension
quads.notes: 3 hard straight sets (FST-7 is off quads this block). 1 s squeeze, last set to failure + bottom partials.

hamstrings.name: Romanian Deadlift
hamstrings.notes: Top set after ramp-ups (warm-ups not logged), then back-offs about 15-20% lighter. Control the negative.

hamstrings.name: Leg Press

hamstrings.name: Seated Leg Curl

calves.name: Seated Calf Raise

calves.name: Leg Press Calf Raise

upper.name: Incline Bench Press

upper.name: Incline DB Press

upper.name: Machine Chest Press
upper.notes: Chin up, chest proud (tucking the chin cuts the range). 2 reps in reserve.

upper.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
upper.notes: Lowest pulley, fixed soft elbows, pinkies up, scoop to chin height. Touch, don't cross. Pause-squeeze every rep.

upper.name: Pec Deck

mid.name: Bench Press

mid.name: Cable Fly

lower.name: Incline Machine Press

lower.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly

lower.name: Barbell Curl

lower.name: Skull Crusher
lower.notes: Superset A2 with Barbell Curl. Lower behind head for long-head stretch.

lower.name: Incline DB Curl

lower.name: Overhead Cable Extension
lower.notes: Superset B2 with Incline DB Curl. Elbows tucked, full stretch.

lower.name: Preacher Curl
lower.notes: 2 hard straight sets (FST-7 is off arms this block). 1 s squeeze, last set to failure + partials.

lower.name: Rope Pushdown
lower.notes: 2 hard straight sets. Split the rope at the bottom, last set to failure + partials.

upper.name: Lat Pulldown
upper.notes: Opener, underhand grip. 2 x 8, then rest-pause: set 1 one rest-pause, set 2 two rest-pauses (10-15 s each, max reps). Blades into your back pocket, one fluid pull, don't over-arch. No straps until top sets. Log the 8s; rest-pause reps are bonus.

upper.name: Pull-Up
upper.notes: Weight = added load. After the pulldown opener now, so a touch lighter. Full hang, chest to bar. No straps until top sets.

upper.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
upper.notes: Pause 1 s at the top, no hip drive.

upper.name: Single-Arm DB Row
upper.notes: Supinated high row: elbow to the hip pocket, shoulder down, no shrug. Long stretch at the bottom.

upper.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
upper.notes: Double rope, 45 deg hinge, chest down, soft fixed elbows, spread the rope past the hips, bottom partials on the last reps. FST-7: one weight all 7 sets, 10-12 reps, 30-45 s rest. Between sets FLEX/pose the target 10 s, building to 30 s (no stretching during the 7s). Sip ~2 oz water before and after each flex.
